lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct vertical white lines traversing the flank. Spacing is largely equidistant across the mid-section, becoming slightly more compressed towards the posterior.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: One prominent Y-shaped bifurcation is visible on the 8th line from the posterior, where the line splits in the upper third of the torso.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The first three lines from the posterior are highly fragmented, appearing as series of dots or dashed segments that do not reach the ventral midline.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A grouping of 6-8 high-contrast white spots is concentrated on the lateral surface of the posterior haunch, positioned above the stifle joint.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Three spots on the mid-haunch align horizontally to form a semi-continuous geometric line segment.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Developing horn spikes emerge at a near-linear 75-degree angle from the frontal bone, showing minimal lyrate curvature at this growth stage.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The distance between the terminal tips is roughly equal (1:1 ratio) to the width between the horn bases.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible white chevron marking between the eyes, dual white malar spots on the cheek, and high-contrast white leg stockings extending from the hooves to the mid-carpus/tarsus.
